Maya Patel: Ran the midday fused-attn smoke runs (QKV packing + bias/rope epilogue) on the nv8a pool. Most seq lengths look fine but seq=512 shows a nasty p99 spike for small batches. anyone else see this? :thinking:
Liam Chen: can you paste the numbers? which model/commit?
Maya Patel: model=redwood/fused-small (local build from main@7f3c). kernels: fused_qkv_pack + epilogue_bias_rope. hw=A100-80GB (nv8a). batcher=continuous, batch size tunable, default kv config. quick output:```
seq=256 batch=8 p50=28ms p95=42ms p99=60ms
seq=512 batch=8 p50=40ms p95=95ms p99=210ms  <-- big gap
tokens/sec drops ~35% at seq=512
```:disappointed:
Arjun Rao: hmm looks like cache fragmentation / allocator churn. seq=512 increases KV pages and we might be triggering a different code path in paged-KV allocator when QKV packing changes layout. did you try forcing kv-align?
Maya Patel: not yet. quick experiment: toggled --kv-align=64 and reran, p99 came down to ~75ms (still worse than 256 but not catastrophic).
Sophia Kim: can you run with nvprof or CUPTI trace? i'd like to see SM occupancy and if epilogue kernels are launching more often / longer.
Maya Patel: attached a tiny nvprof snippet (trimmed):```
== GPU Profiling summary ==
Kernel: fused_qkv_pack_epilogue  calls=120  avg_ms=0.48  p95_ms=1.8  sm_eff=32%
Kernel: attention_core        calls=240  avg_ms=0.72  p95_ms=2.1  sm_eff=68%
note: at seq=512 the epilogue call count + runtime jumps, occupancy drops on epilogue.
```
Arjun Rao: occupancy drop + epilogue runtime increase screams memory-bound epilogue. packing changes layout so epilogue does more scattered writes (rope+bias interleave). That can hurt when paged kv causes extra memcpy. try two quick knobs: (1) kv-align=128 (2) disable packing on qkv and run epilogue fusion only.
Maya Patel: ran both: kv-align=128 helps more than 64. disabling qkv-packing returns to baseline (p99 ~62ms). so interaction between packing and KV page boundaries is real.
Liam Chen: do we have a reproducer script we can add to perf suite? ideally a small harness that toggles allocator and packing so CI can catch regressions.
Sophia Kim: +1. also collect small flamegraphs for host-to-device memcpy. i suspect extra cudaMemcpy calls when pages rebind.
Maya Patel: created quick bench invocations:```
./bench --model fused --seq 512 --batch 8 --kernel fused_qkv_pack --epilogue bias_rope --kv-align 64
./bench --model fused --seq 512 --batch 8 --kernel fused_no_pack --epilogue bias_rope --kv-align 128
```
I'll add to perf/benchmarks/smoke_fused_kv_align.sh and upload results.
PerfBot: benchmark job 1935007788 started on nv8a pool. (automated run)
Arjun Rao: long term: we should make paged-KV allocator aware of packing semantics so it can avoid page splits that turn contiguous writes into scatter. maybe a heuristic: prefer allocations aligned to fused-packing stride when packing enabled.
Liam Chen: agree. also consider a runtime guard: if epilogue p95> threshold for seq>256, force fallback to non-packed kernel or increase alignment. that gives graceful degradation in prod.
Sophia Kim: can we add a small unit test that simulates kv page fragmentation (allocate/free pattern) and assert no >2x slowdown for epilogue? helps prevent regression.
Maya Patel: will draft a PR: allocator: kv-alignHint + runtime check + perf test. attaching initial numbers to the PR in a sec. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
Liam Chen: nice investigation. file the follow-up ticket (ENGRUNTIME-4723) and assign to arjun for allocator design and maya for the perf harness. i'll add canary rollout to dedicated pool to monitor.
Maya Patel: filed ENGRUNTIME-4723, added notes and reproducer links. last run summary: baseline seq=256 p99~60ms, seq=512 p99~210ms -> kv-align=128 improves seq512 p99~78ms, disable qkv-packing returns p99~62ms. will iterate on allocator changes next week.
